interface.title: BraggFlow — Processamento FBG (Sinais FBG · processamento & figuras)
interface.field: Fiber-optic sensing / photonics (fiber Bragg grating and etched-FBG sensors, e.g. gas or strain sensing)
interface.stage_of_work: Signal processing of raw instrument output, interval statistics, and making publication figures
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn raw FBG interrogator time series (and optical spectra) into cleaned, filtered, temperature-compensated Δλ signals, split them into intervals at marked events for statistics, and export styled publication figures.

data.note: I created a project called 'Ensaio EFBG sintetico' and uploaded synthetic_interrogator.asc (9,001 samples at about 10 Hz over 900 s; 3 channels near 1550, 1545 and 1540 nm) in Séries temporais, and synthetic_spectrum.txt (2,001 points, 3 reflection peaks in dBm) in Espectros. synthetic_gas_events.csv is reference data, not an app input. It was added once as a time series to see how the app handles it, was read as a 6-sample series, made processing fail, and was removed from the project (see not_done).

tree.general: Turn a raw multi-sensor optical recording into clean, drift-free signals, quantify the response in each phase of the experiment, and produce a publication figure
tree.specific: Process an FBG interrogator export (2 EFBGs + reference FBG) to compensated Δλ, mark gas ON/OFF events, compute interval statistics, and export a figure in the Figura tab

features.name: Ordered processing pipeline with live raw-vs-processed overlay
features.general: Stack signal-processing steps that can each be switched on or off and configured; the plot redraws the processed signal over the raw one after every change, and a button writes the result to a file
features.specific: Etapas · de cima para baixo: Limpeza do interrogador, Eixo de tempo, Remoção de nulos, Remoção de outliers, Savitzky-Golay, Média móvel, Passa-baixa/Passa-alta Butterworth, Δλ, Compensação de temperatura. 'Reprocessar ao mudar opções' and 'Sinal bruto' show the effect right away; Processar ▶ / Baixar CSV write the processed CSV
steps: Expand a step card and set its parameters
Switch the step on or off
Watch the processed curve redraw over the raw signal
Swap one method for another (moving average → Butterworth low-pass)
Press Processar ▶ and Baixar CSV
serves_tasks: Remove invalid readings, sudden spikes and outliers, and put the samples on an even time grid
Smooth the signal
Express each signal as a shift from its starting baseline
Subtract thermal drift measured by a reference sensor
Save the processed data as a file

features.name: Channel-to-sensor table with band suggestion and reusable setups
features.general: Map raw instrument channels to named sensors, each with an allowed value range and a calibration constant; auto-suggest the ranges and save the mapping for future runs
features.specific: Sensores card: name (filled in from the file), banda mín/máx and K_T per CH_n with λ₀ shown; 'Sugerir bandas vazias (λ₀ ± até 2 nm)'; 'ocultar' drops a channel; Salvar setup / Setup salvo
steps: Check the channel names read from the file
Press Sugerir bandas vazias to fill the bands
Type K_T for each grating
Hide a channel you don't need
Name and save the setup, then pick it later from Setup salvo
serves_tasks: Check each channel's name and set its valid measurement range and calibration constant
Save the sensor description so later runs with the same hardware can reuse it
Leave a channel out of the analysis, then bring it back

features.name: Reference-sensor drift compensation
features.general: Remove a common disturbance (e.g. temperature) from each sensor by subtracting a scaled copy of a reference sensor's signal, with the scale factor taken from calibration constants
features.specific: Compensação de temperatura: choose Canal de referência (FBG); k = K_T,s / K_T,r from the Sensores card (or the default k); it needs Δλ turned on
steps: Enter a K_T for each sensor
Turn on Δλ (baseline)
Choose the reference channel
Turn on compensation and compare the flattened baseline with the raw signal
serves_tasks: Subtract thermal drift measured by a reference sensor

features.name: Three-mode chart interaction (zoom / measure / mark)
features.general: One time-series chart whose drag gesture can be switched between zooming, measuring a stretch, and placing event markers
features.specific: The 'O que o arraste do mouse faz' radio group: Zoom (drag zooms, double-click resets; key Z), Medir trecho (drag shows a stats table with Copiar, Esc clears; key M), Marcar (click adds a marker, dragging a marker moves it; key A). It works with Canais separados / Mesmo gráfico and Relativo ao início
steps: Choose the mode
Drag or click on the chart
Read the result (zoomed view, measurement table, new marker row)
Copy the measurement or double-click to reset
serves_tasks: Compare channels on one axis or separately, with or without the raw data, and zoom into a time window
Measure statistics of any stretch picked by dragging
Mark when experimental conditions changed

features.name: Event markers with interval and step statistics
features.general: Split a recording at labelled event times and get, for every interval and channel, summary statistics, steady-state value, comparison with a reference interval, and the step change at each event, exportable as CSV
features.specific: Marcações list (t, legenda, cor; '+ Adicionar marcação', ×) feeds Estatísticas por intervalo (Janela de regime, Janela do degrau, Comparar com intervalo anterior/primeiro intervalo/não comparar, Calcular, Baixar CSV) and a 'Degrau em cada marcação' table (not captured on a kept screen). The same markers appear in the Figura tab
steps: Place markers on the chart or type their times
Label them
Set the steady-state and step windows
Choose the comparison interval and press Calcular
Download the stats CSV
serves_tasks: Mark when experimental conditions changed
Compute summary statistics for each interval between events

features.name: Spectrum peak/valley finder with width and Q
features.general: Crop and smooth a spectrum, detect peaks or valleys above a prominence threshold, and tabulate position, width at half-maximum or 3 dB, Q, centroid and spacing
features.specific: Espectros: Recorte e suavização (λ min/max, Savitzky-Golay or moving average, detrend, normalization, offset) and Picos e vales (Máximos/Mínimos, linear FWHM or dB 3-dB band, prominence, minimum distance). The plot shows markers and width bars, and the Picos e vales table has Baixar CSV
steps: Load a spectrum
Set the crop and smoothing
Choose peaks or valleys and the intensity scale
Set a prominence threshold
Read and download the table
serves_tasks: Load a spectrum, crop and smooth it, and find its peaks with their widths

features.name: Publication figure builder with journal presets and saved styles
features.general: Render a data file (time series or spectra) as a server-side vector or bitmap figure; switch between stacked and overlaid layouts, apply journal size presets and palettes, and save the whole style for reuse
features.specific: Figura tab cards: Estilo e tamanho (IEEE/Elsevier/A4/16:9 presets, font, Salvar estilo/Restaurar padrão), Dados (Série no tempo / Espectros / Evolução, nm→pm, x unit, limits), Curvas (palette, per-curve legend/line/marker/colour, legend position), Figura (Separados/Juntos, size, title, panel labels), Marcações e eixos (t = 0 at first marker, bands, PT/EN labels, decimal comma). Atualizar ▶, Copiar figura, and Baixar figura in PDF/PNG/SVG/EPS/TIFF at a chosen dpi

serves_tasks: Plot the processed time series as stacked panels with the events shown
